description: The Heritage `make "name" value` spelling (spec/grammar.md:105, spec/conformance.md:270 — alternate spelling, no new semantics) lowers to the same Assign shape as `set … to`, so `make "count" 7` binds `count` and the later `print :count` prints 7. Tagged profile:heritage; the source uses no Core-forbidden construct, so it also parses/executes on the saga branch before the Heritage form-head profile gate (issue #667) lands.
